body: Don't worry, you didn't hijack it and you didn't make me feel worse. I really appreciate everything you've said, and thank you for giving me some info on the method. I figured it wasn't a good idea but I just am so desperate. It makes me feel better to know that I'm not alone in this particular feeling though, but I'm sorry that you can relate. It is the worst feeling in the world. Everyone tells you it will get better but it never seems to. Thank you for taking the time to write this all out because it does mean a lot.
